title: Add loose fibres to the rug
author: claude
summary: Loose fibres give the rug a soft fuzz and a fringe at its edge.
what: A second generator makes loose fibres, which are layered on the rug for fuzz and used for the edge fringe.
why: A flat texture looks too clean. Loose fibres add the softness of real wool.
how: The fibres are a small picture with see-through areas, 1024 pixels wide and covering 0.25 m.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
